text:
alex: Quick question — I'm going to change the billing-db StatefulSet to scale from 3 -> 2 and switch updateStrategy to a partitioned rolling update for a gentle rollout. Any immediate gotchas (PVC deletion, quorum, PDBs)?

maya: heads up on quorum — if you drop replicas we need to ensure the DB can tolerate 2 replicas (leader + follower). Also check retention of PVCs: dynamic provisioners usually delete PV when PVC is deleted unless storageclass reclaimPolicy is Retain. :eyes:

leo: for StatefulSet scaling the controller deletes the highest ordinal pod first (N-1). PVCs tied to claim templates will be deleted if the PVC is removed and the underlying PV reclaimPolicy=Delete. If you want to keep volumes, set reclaimPolicy=Retain or snapshot before scale. Also consider a PodDisruptionBudget rather than relying on replicas for availability.

alex: thanks. Planning to patch infra with a var and apply via terraform. Example of the k8s snippet I'm thinking (updateStrategy + resources):

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: billing-db
spec:
  replicas: 2
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 0   # full rolling update, change to 1 for canary
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: postgres
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "1Gi"
          limits:
            cpu: "1"
            memory: "2Gi"
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: billing-db-creds
```

alex: Also adding the terraform change like: 
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_stateful_set" "billing_db" {
  metadata { name = "billing-db" }
  spec {
    replicas = var.billing_db_replicas
    # ... rest of spec mirrored from manifest/template
  }
}
```

maya: Sounds fine. When you open the infra PR, please include a plan output and highlight any storageclass with reclaimPolicy=Delete. We'll want a snapshot if volumes must be preserved.

rohit: on secret wiring — we're still using sealed-secrets for this cluster or did we migrate to ExternalSecrets? If sealed-secrets, remember to encrypt the secret and commit the SealedSecret; if ExternalSecrets, add an ExternalSecret manifest pointing at aws-secretmanager / vault with refresh policy. Mounting as envFrom is fine but consider projected volume if certs/keys need file path access.

leo: and a note on canary: StatefulSet doesn't support maxUnavailable like Deployment. Use rollingUpdate.partition to keep N pods at old version. Typical flow: set partition = current_replicas to freeze, then lower partition by 1 to advance canary one pod at a time.

alex: good tip. So plan: (1) open infra PR with var change + updated manifest + terraform plan (2) include snapshot plan if reclaimPolicy=Delete (3) add SealedSecret (rohit) or ExternalSecret config (rohit) (4) apply in maintenance window and monitor.

infra-bot: CI: terraform plan completed for branch alex/sts-scale — no drift, 1 resource to change.

sre-bot: Rollout monitor: starting canary after apply — will watch readiness for 10min per pod.

maya: I'll review the PR, please tag me. Quick check: add a note about expected downtime (should be none) and rollout steps (partition change sequence).

alex: will do. tagging you in the PR and adding checklist. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

leo: I'll keep an eye on metrics during the rollout (latency, DB replication lag). If anything spikes we abort and revert partition to previous value.

rohit: I'll prepare the secret artifact and update docs for the secret rotation process.

alex: final: PR link will be posted in this thread when ready. planning to apply in the 03:00 UTC window tomorrow.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled terraform apply at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z (maintenance window).
